::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** March 6 th [1869]  
**Manuscript:** MS Mrs Clare Roels
:::

My dear [Christabel](people/person_329.qmd)
You and [Mary Arnold](people/person_1467.qmd) are very decidedly the best this time, so I don’t send any others. 

You will have to reform the scheme of travelling as [Mignonette](people/person_1637.qmd) and [Sparrow Hawk](people/person_97.qmd) both resign in much haste[^1]

yr affect 
Mother Goose

---

[^1]: The circulation of essays between the various members of the [Gosling Society](organizations/other_104.qmd) caused endless trouble.
